name: Supplies for Nethergarde
summary: Quartermaster Lungertz needs the Crate of Powerstones before its contents expire. You are asked to bring it to him.

sections.title: A Timely Delivery
sections.body: The Crate of Powerstones is meant for Quartermaster Lungertz. You are asked to bring it to him before the powerstones expire.

faq.q: What do I bring to Quartermaster Lungertz?
faq.answer: You are asked to bring Quartermaster Lungertz the Crate of Powerstones.

faq.q: Why is the delivery time sensitive?
faq.answer: The powerstones will expire, so the crate needs to reach Quartermaster Lungertz before then.
Quartermaster Lungertz receives the Crate of Powerstones.

attribution: In-game quest text: Supplies for Nethergarde
